subject: SSI refresh - beneficiary coordinates (ref 2026/Q4/118)
text:
Counterparty Operations,

Please be advised of a refresh of our Standard Settlement Instructions for USD. The below supersedes all prior SSIs held for Halvorsen Group entities with value date on or after 15-Dec-2026.

Kindly amend your static data accordingly and acknowledge by return.

Treasury Middle Office
